scope: one bounded analysis of an existing private YUV file, performed entirely on the Lumia
setup_note: The first temporary APK had a manifest namespace mismatch and failed before analysis. The activity declaration was corrected, rebuilt, and the corrected APK completed the saved-frame analysis.

result.whole_frame_contrast_fallback: no candidate; the downsampled luma exceeded the provisional signal floor
result.interpretation: The frame contains spatial variation, but the generic detector found no eye-box proposal. It is not a usable iris sample and does not establish matcher behavior.

source_changes: Saved-frame aggregate diagnostics can display while the camera is closed.
The app no longer requests camera permission at startup; permission is requested only when Open iris is selected.
Saved-frame summary withholds eye-box coordinates and reports only whether a generic proposal was found.
The YUV read buffer, downsample sums/counts, spatial-quality accumulators, and plane summaries are overwritten after analysis.
limitations: The original frame was captured under uncontrolled visible room light with IR off.
Spatial luma metrics do not prove iris texture resolution; detector failure is inconclusive for a dedicated iris view.
The negative whole-frame result is one room-scene observation and does not validate false-positive rejection on other scenes.
The temporary analyzer used the existing Camera2 probe activity and did not open the camera or request LED control.
Java array overwrites remain best effort rather than guaranteed secure erasure.
publication: local only; no commit, push, or PR
